collection.aboutFallback: Shop {title} online at Colombo Market — {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} picked for everyday cooking, pantry restocking and family meals. Order online for delivery across Germany or pick up in-store in Ravensburg.

items.a: Most orders arrive within 1–3 business days across Germany. In-store pickup in Ravensburg is also available.

items.q: Do you guarantee the freshness of vegetables?
items.a: Yes — fresh produce is sourced a few times a week and any item that arrives below our freshness standard is refunded or replaced, no questions asked.

items.q: Can you source a specific product for me?
items.a: If you're after a brand or item we don't currently stock, send us a message and our buying team will look into adding it.

items.q: How can I get in touch?
items.a: Use the chat bubble in the corner of the site, or email our support team — we typically reply within one business day.

seoContent.title: Sri Lankan, Indian & International Shopping, Made Simple
seoContent.paragraph1: Colombo Market brings authentic spices, rice, lentils and specialty foods from Sri Lanka, India and around the world to Ravensburg — for everyday cooking and special occasions alike.
seoContent.paragraph2: Categories are organised the way home cooks actually shop, with clear unit pricing on every product. Orders can be picked up at our Ravensburg store or delivered to your door.
